profile.headline: Software Developer at IBM

positions.title: Virtualization Software Developer
positions.description:
Software development for the Linux Kernel KVM, QEMU, Libvirt virtualization stack, for the IBM Z Series mainframes.

https://github.com/qemu/qemu/commit/666dd3c9b10a70eea4aae3c09b0f945175a7cb8e

positions.title: Backend Software Developer
positions.description:
- Promoted within my first 2 years.
- Lead a development team in creating the infrastructure to migrate our codebase to GitHub Enterprise from an internal SCM. Mentored interns. (Leadership and Large-scale change.)
- Developed and unit tested new functionality for IBM’s z/VM virtual machine environment. Virtualized the I/O architecture of IBM Z series mainframes. (Operating systems development, legacy code, kernel, hypervisor, mainframe.)

positions.title: Camp Instructor (Computer Science)
positions.locationName: SUNY New Paltz University, New York
positions.description: Taught Python-based courses in object oriented programming, app development, and neural networks.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant (Physics)
positions.description: Studied the quantum properties of graphene in Bard College's Nanolab Physics Lab. Published a paper.

positions.title: Captain of High School Solar Car Building Team
positions.description: Club Head and Lead Designer of Solar Car Building Team at my high school, Ulster BOCES in Port Ewen, NY. Our three-wheeled solar-electric vehicle placed 2nd in the Solar Car Challenge race across the country, from Dallas to Minneapolis.

positions.title: MIT-Lemelson $10,000 Award Recipient
positions.description: I was the Lead Programmer on a robotic exoskeleton hand device purposed for the rehabilitation of hand paralysis. My team and I received a $10,000 award to refine our device, and were invited to present our prototype on MIT Campus at MIT's EurekaFest.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Classics and Classical Languages, Literatures, and Linguistics
